newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates crawl down, seen easing.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates crawl down, seen easing.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates crawled down on Sunday in the absence of exporters and spinners, dealers said.

Rates eased as exporters stayed out due to high prices, while spinners postponed buying till after the Moslem Eid al-Fitr festival in the second week of February, dealer A.E. Mohammadi of the private Karachi Cotton Association said.
In the kerb market, the rate for NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,275 and 2,325 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
Exporters shipped 15,720 375-lb bales between September 1 and December 31 compared to 541,722 in the year-ago period, a KCA official said.
